import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tools')
import campaign
campaign.PLAN_DEADLINE = 25.0
job = json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/plan4096.json'))
start=time.time()
out = campaign.audit(job)
print('elapsed %.1f resolved %d cost %d' % (time.time()-start, out['plan']['resolved'], out['plan']['cost']))
import shape
shape.check_result(job, out)
print('shape verified')
# independent feasibility check of the truncated plan
requests = {r['id']: r for r in job['requests']}
offers = {o['id']: o for r in [()] for o in []} if False else {o['id']: o for o in job['offers']}
import collections, ipaddress
used=set(); ocount=collections.Counter(); rq=collections.Counter(); oq=collections.Counter(); cost=0
parents = {n['id']: n['parent'] for n in job['request_quotas']}
capr = {n['id']: n['capacity'] for n in job['request_quotas']}
parentso = {n['id']: n['parent'] for n in job['offer_quotas']}
capo = {n['id']: n['capacity'] for n in job['offer_quotas']}
active = {r['id']: r['active'] for r in out['active_requests']}
lease_end = {l['id']: l['end'] for l in job['leases']}
for row in out['plan']['assignments']:
    r = requests[row['request']]; o = offers[row['offer']]
    assert row['request'] not in used; used.add(row['request'])
    assert active[row['request']]
    assert row['request'] in o['requests']
    assert r['service'] == o['service']
    assert r['at'] <= o['time'] < lease_end[r['lease']]
    assert ipaddress.IPv6Address(r['target']) in ipaddress.IPv6Network(o['prefix'])
    ocount[row['offer']] += 1
    cost += o['cost']
    g = r['group']
    while g: rq[g]+=1; g=parents[g]
    rq[parents and r['group']] += 0
    g = r['group']
    # root node counted once more below
    top = parents.get(r['group'])
    while top: rq[top]+=1; top=parents.get(top)
    g = o['group']
    while g: oq[g]+=1; g=parentso.get(g)
for oid,c in ocount.items(): assert c <= offers[oid]['capacity'], oid
for n,c in rq.items(): assert c <= capr[n], (n,c)
for n,c in oq.items(): assert c <= capo[n], (n,c)
assert cost == out['plan']['cost'], (cost, out['plan']['cost'])
print('truncated plan is feasible:', len(used), 'assignments')
PY
